sources.snippet: Runs one of dcarpintero's ModernBERT encoder classifiers over a single user prompt and reports whether the text is a prompt-injection / jailbreak attempt. Each model is a two-class sequence classifier whose unsafe class is labeled "unsafe"; the guardrail treats that class as the risky one. The default pangolin-guard-base is ModernBERT-base; pangolin-guard-large is a higher-accuracy ModernBERT ...
